verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services SaaS, and such a service could plausibly publish official SDKs or a partner API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SDK, API, or developer library. The llms.txt probe is guidance for AI crawlers, not an SDK, so it earns no credit.
